newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bank shares rise on ownership news.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bank shares rise on ownership news.

text.p: South Korean banking shares rose in Monday's afternoon trading on a media report that the finance ministry would raise the individual bank ownership ceiling to 15 percent from the current four percent, brokers said.
A ministry official said the government would make an announcement this week on bank ownership but declined to elaborate.
The banking sub-index rose 2.4 percent to 402.21 at 0520 GMT.

The Naeway Economic Daily said on Monday the government would expand the ceiling to 15 percent. It also said the ministry would allow conglomerates or chaebols to jointly own and run commercial banks.

"Some investors believe the chaebols' participation will help restructure the banking sector," said Choi Dong-chul at Ssangyong Securities. "The others bought banking shares for quick profits following the news." -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
